name: @aliceo2/tokenization-frontend
description: A react-router based application for the GUI respective to the tokenization system

scripts.docker:typecheck: docker compose exec webapp npm run typecheck
scripts.docker:test:build: cd .. && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up --build --abort-on-container-exit ui-tests && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml stop && cd ./webapp
scripts.docker:test: cd .. && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up --abort-on-container-exit ui-tests && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml stop && cd ./webapp
